newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Third auction likely for South Korea's Hanbo Steel.
newsitem.headline: Third auction likely for South Korea's Hanbo Steel.

text.p: Creditors of South Korea's Hanbo Steel Co will likely agree to try for the third time to auction off the failed steelmaker, a spokesman for main creditor Korea First Bank said on Thursday.
He said the decision would be finalised during a meeting of Hanbo's 15 main creditors on Friday at 3 p.m. (0600 GMT).
This would not mean an offer by Pohang Iron and Steel Co Ltd (POSCO) would be rejected, he said. POSCO's proposal would be discussed on Friday, he said.
At the second auction for Hanbo Steel on Tuesday, POSCO offered to buy Hanbo Steel's fixed assets along with Dong Kuk Steel Mill Co Ltd

After no bidders showed up for the auction, POSCO's executive manager Park Chong-il told a news conference that POSCO had estimated the purchase price of Hanbo's fixed assets at about two trillion won.
This compared to an accounting firm's evaluation of 4.15 trillion won for Hanbo's fixed assets.
But the bank spokesman said creditors were unlikely to take action on POSCO's offer at Friday's meeting.
